children.title: International Transactions and Open-Economy Identities
children.description: Calculate and interpret exports, imports, net exports, net capital outflow, and open-economy saving identities.

children.title: Nominal Exchange Rates and Currency Values
children.description: Interpret exchange-rate quotations, conversions, reciprocal rates, appreciation, and depreciation.

children.title: Real Exchange Rates and Purchasing Power
children.description: Calculate real exchange rates and evaluate purchasing-power parity as a long-run benchmark.

children.title: Capital Flows and Net Capital Outflow
children.description: Classify international asset purchases, calculate NCO, and trace real-interest-rate and risk effects on capital flows.

children.title: Foreign-Exchange Market Equilibrium
children.description: Analyze demand for and supply of domestic currency, equilibrium currency values, and single or simultaneous shifts.

children.title: Open-Economy Policy and Macroeconomic Transmission
children.description: Trace fiscal policy, trade policy, capital flight, and monetary changes through saving, interest rates, NCO, exchange rates, net exports, and aggregate demand.

rationale: Separates accounting identities from behavioral capital-flow mechanisms.
Keeps nominal-rate quotation skills distinct from real-rate and PPP reasoning.
Gives the foreign-exchange market its own graph-centered child.
Reserves multi-market fiscal, trade, monetary, and capital-flight chains for policy transmission.
Avoids duplication of the existing Micro international-trade family.
